intro.name: Yui
intro.bio: I take K-beauty skincare brands from first quote to a compliant shipment across Europe and Russia/CIS. With a background in food marketing and sensory science, and a brand I founded myself, I care about how products land with real customers.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I earned a <degree>B.S. from the College of Life Sciences</degree>, focusing on food marketing and sensory science, and wrote my thesis on how origin labels shape consumer trust. During university I <position>founded a regional food brand, HUP</position>. After roles in <industry>quality assurance and regulatory affairs</industry>, I joined MIRAERO KOREA CO., LTD., where I <learning>manage overseas accounts</learning> in Poland, Spain, Lithuania, Italy and Russia/CIS. <favorite>What I enjoy most</favorite> is connecting the commercial side with the paperwork that lets a product actually cross a border. I <love>love</love> seeing a brand land well in a new market. My core strengths are <stack>OEM/ODM project management, EU regulatory compliance and pricing</stack>. <seeking>I am open to roles in international sales and brand management.</seeking>
about.paragraph2: <notCoding>Outside work</notCoding>, I trained in <learning>fashion design</learning> and still create visuals in Photoshop and Illustrator. I lived in Turin for two months and am <studying>learning Italian</studying>.
